manage.title: Update your website
manage.intro: Edit shared images, links and contact details once under English in Pages CMS. Edit English and Khmer wording in their own menus.
manage.signText: Sign in to Pages CMS with GitHub and choose the website repository.
manage.changeText: Use English + shared images and links for photos, URLs, dates and common company details. Use ភាសាខ្មែរ for Khmer text and image descriptions.
manage.reviewText: Wait for your host to finish building. Check / and /kh for the updated content.
manage.note: The editor requires a connected GitHub repository and Pages CMS access. This page itself is a public guide, not a login or a content editor.
manage.enHint: Choose English + shared images and links for common photos, URLs and contact details.
manage.khHint: Choose ភាសាខ្មែរ · អត្ថបទ for Khmer text and image descriptions.
